connector.name: MCP Server by ARCXS-Protocol
connector.registryDescription: The DNS/SMTP for AI agents: cross-protocol discovery, messaging and transactions. No middleman fees.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the arcxs-protocol account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ARCXS_API_KEY
env.description: API key for authenticated operations (register, message, heartbeat). Get one free at https://arcxs.net/dashboard. Not required for search, lookup, or health checks.

env.name: ARCXS_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL for the ARCXS API. Defaults to https://arcxs.net
